PREET PAL SINGH Joint Secretary MINISTRY OF EDUCATION (DEPARTMENT OF HIGHER EDUCATION) New Delhi, the 25th February 2026 No. 10-9/2024-U.3(A)—Whereas, Vels Institute of Science Technology and Advanced Studies (VISTAS) (Deemed to be University), Tamil Nadu submitted an online application on UGC Portal to start an off-campus Centre at Velan Nagar, Periyapalayam Road, Manjankaranai Village, Uthukkottai, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu as per the UGC (Institutions deemed to be Universities) Regulations, 2023. 2. And whereas, UGC, vide its letter No.40-8/2025 (CPP-I/DU) dated 13.08.2025, informed that the application was examined through its Standing Committee. The Committee, after presentation of the Institution and based on the documents submitted, recommended for issuance of Letter of Intent (LoI) to Vels Institute of Science Technology and Advanced Studies (VISTAS) (Deemed to be University), Tamil Nadu with certain conditions. 3. And further whereas, the Ministry, on the advice of UGC, issued Letter of Intent (LoI) dated 09.09.2025 to Vels Institute of Science Technology and Advanced Studies (VISTAS) (Deemed to be University), Tamil Nadu for fulfilment of certain conditions within a period of 3 years before starting an off-campus at Velan Nagar, Periyapalayam Road, Manjankaranai Village, Uthukkottai, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu. 4. And whereas, the Registrar, Vels Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced Studies (VISTAS) (Deemed to be University), Tamil Nadu, vide letter No. VISTAS/R/MoE/085/2025 dated 15.09.2025, submitted compliance report in respect of fulfilment of the conditions of the LoI. The same was forwarded to UGC for verification and further advice. In response, UGC, vide letter dated 27.01.2026, informed that the compliance report was accepted by the Standing Committee and recommended for final approval in the matter. 5. Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, the Ministry of Education, on the advice of UGC, hereby accords approval to Vels Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced Studies (VISTAS) (Deemed to be University), Tamil Nadu to start an off-campus Centre at Velan Nagar, Periyapalayam Road, Manjankaranai Village, Uthukkottai, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu subject to the condition that admissions under professional courses shall be made only after obtaining approval from the respective Regulatory Councils/Bodies. 6. All other conditions mentioned in the earlier Notification(s) of this Ministry as well as the Rules / Regulations of UGC and other Statutory Councils, issued from time to time, shall continue to be adhered by Vels Institute of Science Technology and Advanced Studies (VISTAS) (Deemed to be University), Tamil Nadu.
